newsitem.title: UK: Booker sells Prepared Foods Group.
newsitem.headline: Booker sells Prepared Foods Group.

text.p: British food distributor Booker Plc said on Tuesday that it has sold its Prepared Foods Group for 57 million stg to a management buy-in team backed by 3I Plc.

Charles Bowen, chief executive of Booker, said in a statement, "This disposal continues Booker's strategy of focusing on its core business in food distribution, poultry, aquaculture and fish processing."
Booker said that the proceeds from the sale would be used to reduce group debt.

The management team of Prize Food Group Ltd, the company formed to buy the Prepared Foods Group, was led by David Sims and Michael Russell, formerly chief executive and finance director respectively of Nurdin & Peacock Plc.
Booker bought Nurdin & Peacock last year.
Equity backing for the management buy-in team was provided by 3I and debt funding by Robert Fleming. Lazard Brothers advised Booker on the sale.
